notes: A228469_conjecture: a(n) (defined by a(n) = 6a(n-2)+a(n-4)) is the least c > 0 with some b > 0 and trace(b,c) = first n+1 letters of the alternating word (reading: offset 0, a(0) for one letter). General theorem A228469.least_c: for any word, least c from a backward greedy (multipliers 2 for letter 0, 3 for letter 1), proved minimal by monotonicity in coordinates t = y - 2y', u = y'. Two backward steps have trace 6, det -1, giving the recurrence. Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none.
